summary: GRI 407 addresses freedom of association and collective bargaining, both internationally recognized human rights of workers and employers. It contains one disclosure on operations and suppliers where these rights may be at risk and measures taken to support them.

questions.text: Describe the actual and potential, negative and positive impacts of the organization on the economy, environment and people, including impacts on their human rights, in relation to freedom of association and collective bargaining.
questions.hint: Cover both actual and potential impacts, negative and positive, including impacts on human rights.

questions.text: Is the organization involved with the negative impacts related to freedom of association and collective bargaining through its own activities or as a result of its business relationships? Describe those activities or business relationships.
questions.hint: State whether involvement is through the organization's activities or through its business relationships, and describe them.

questions.text: Describe the organization's policies or commitments regarding freedom of association and collective bargaining.
questions.hint: Describe the policies or commitments that apply to this material topic.

questions.text: Describe the actions taken to manage freedom of association and collective bargaining and the related impacts, including (i) actions to prevent or mitigate potential negative impacts, (ii) actions to address actual negative impacts, including actions to provide for or cooperate in their remediation, and (iii) actions to manage actual and potential positive impacts.
questions.hint: Cover i. prevention or mitigation of potential negative impacts; ii. addressing actual negative impacts, including remediation; iii. managing positive impacts.

questions.text: How does the organization track the effectiveness of the actions taken? Describe (i) the processes used, (ii) the goals, targets and indicators used to evaluate progress, (iii) the effectiveness of the actions, including progress toward goals and targets, and (iv) lessons learned and how they have been incorporated into operational policies and procedures.
questions.hint: Cover i. tracking processes; ii. goals, targets and indicators; iii. effectiveness and progress; iv. lessons learned and how they were incorporated.

questions.text: Describe how engagement with stakeholders has informed the actions taken (3-3-d) and how it has informed whether the actions have been effective (3-3-e).
questions.hint: Explain the role of stakeholder engagement in shaping actions and in judging their effectiveness.

disclosures.title: Operations and suppliers in which the right to freedom of association and collective bargaining may be at risk

questions.text: Have you identified operations and suppliers in which workers' rights to exercise freedom of association or collective bargaining may be violated or at significant risk? If so, identify them in terms of (i) type of operation (such as manufacturing plant) and supplier, and (ii) countries or geographic areas considered at risk.
questions.hint: Select the answer; give type of operation/supplier and countries or areas in your notes.

questions.text: What measures did the organization take in the reporting period intended to support rights to exercise freedom of association and collective bargaining?
questions.hint: Measures taken during the reporting period.
